## Pull request overview Implements the remaining RISC-V `F` extension functionality across the IDL spec/runtime and generated instruction semantics, and updates the surrounding tooling/config to enable and test `F` in the project’s flows. **Changes:** - Adds/updates single-precision FP algorithms and helpers in `spec/std/isa/isa/fp.idl` (mul/div/muladd/sqrt, 64-bit conversions, rounding helpers, etc.). - Hooks new `F` instruction operations into the instruction YAMLs and enables `F` in riscv-tests configs + adds `uf` riscv-tests execution in the cpp backend test task. - Updates Ruby version constraints (Gemfile + gemspecs) and refactors parts of `idlc` AST/pruning/memoization and C++ Bits unknown-mask plumbing. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 39 out of 41 changed files in this pull request and generated 15 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | Gemfile | Broadens supported Ruby versions to `>= 3.2, < 4.0`. | | tools/ruby-gems/*/*.gemspec | Aligns gem Ruby requirements to `>= 3.2, < 4.0`. | | tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/paths.rb | Adds `bundler/setup` require to path helpers. | | tools/ruby-gems/idlc/lib/idlc/ast.rb | Removes `freeze_tree` overrides and introduces memo structs/caching changes. | | tools/ruby-gems/idlc/lib/idlc/passes/prune.rb | Updates pruning behavior for loops/statements. | | tools/ruby-gems/idlc/test/test_expressions.rb | Removes commented assertion referencing removed verbose IDL printer. | | tools/ruby-gems/*/sorbet/rbi/gems/*.rbi | Updates Sorbet RBIs to match modified APIs. | | spec/std/isa/isa/fp.idl | Major expansion/refactor of `F` runtime semantics (SoftFloat-derived routines, rounding, conversions). | | spec/std/isa/isa/globals.isa | Adds an explicit `unreachable()` fallback branch in `xlen`. | | spec/std/isa/inst/F/*.yaml | Wires up more `F` instruction `operation()` bodies to new FP helpers and checks. | | cfgs/rv32-riscv-tests.yaml / cfgs/rv64-riscv-tests.yaml | Enables `F`, expands legal `mstatus.FS` values, and adds `HW_MSTATUS_FS_DIRTY_UPDATE` + `MUTABLE_MISA_F`. | | backends/cpp_hart_gen/tasks.rake | Adds running `rv{32,64}uf` riscv-tests in `test:riscv_tests`. | | backends/cpp_hart_gen/cpp/include/udb/bits.hpp | Adjusts unknown-mask handling and runtime-width return types in bitwise ops. |
